title: Adversarial Machine Learning for Social Good: Reframing the Adversary as an Ally
reasoning: The paper is a comprehensive survey of the field of Adversarial Machine Learning for Social Good (AdvML4G). While it includes 'ML Ethics' and 'Fairness' in its taxonomy and discusses bias mitigation and privacy as pro-social applications, it is a technical review of machine learning methodologies rather than a study or benchmark primarily focused on evaluating religion, faith, or morals.
